_about: BOWART v2 bow_pose.json (laneBOWART, STAGED DARK): the POSE targets of the bow clips as data, read by Tools/bow_clips_build.py (clip timing, keys and gates stay in bow_clips.json). Everything is expressed in the AIM FRAME so no world numbers or names are hard-coded: vectors are [along A (towards the target), up U, front F (the way the archer's chest faces, i.e. the draw-hand side of the face)]; metres from the shoulder / head joint unless stated, degrees. Joint chains are twist-free hinge chains (Arm, ForeArm share ONE hinge axis; Tools/bow_pose.py solve_arm): the roll the palm needs is taken by the elbow swivel psi (searched with the weights below), the forearm and the hand roll at most forearmRollMaxDeg / handRollMaxDeg.

base.note: legs, spine rest and head come from this clip; hips/legs/feet are re-planted by the stance below

stance._about: side-on archer. feet are planted on the shot line (constant world targets, foot slide 0) at feetWidthShoulders x the measured shoulder width, weight even (hips centred between the feet + weightShiftM along A). chestOpenDeg / hipsOpenDeg = degrees from perfectly side-on towards the target (hips a little more open than the chest = the torso is turned into the shot). aim shares = how much of the clip aimYaw the hips / chest follow (feet never move). foot yaw: toes point along F turned footOpenDeg[front, back] towards the target; knees follow the toes (kneePoleUp raises the pole a little). Knees follow the toes: footOpenDeg is kept within a few degrees of hipsOpenDeg so the knee stays over the foot (knee-medial gate 0.02 m).

bow._about: bow arm (left): straight towards the target, locked elbow (reach), elbow swivel searched (pole = preferred elbow direction, weak), fist axis vertical (palm faces F).

draw._about: draw arm (right): upper arm back, elbow about shoulder height (elbowTarget from the shoulder, aim frame), forearm in line with the arrow, string fingers at the anchor (head frame [along, up, front] from the Head joint), hand thumb/knuckle at the jaw, palm to the face. hookDist = wrist to string-fingers distance (the string point is the mean of Index2/Middle2 and is corrected by iteration, so the anchor is exact).
draw._wristNeutralDrop: share of the wrist kept straight (hand continues the forearm) when the hand lets go: 0 = fingers keep pointing where fingerDrop says, 1 = neutral wrist

fingers._about: curl angles per joint (deg) for Index/Middle/Ring/Pinky joints 1..3 and Thumb 1..3. bow: fist around the grip; hook: string fingers at full hook; open: relaxed.

hold._about: bow glb fit to the bow hand. The bow long axis is the fist curl axis (vertical in the aim pose), the string side faces the archer. grip = bow origin position in the hand frame solved from palmAlong/palmDepth (metres from the wrist along the hand bone / out of the palm).

twistGate._about: CPU gate: roll between neighbouring bones about the bone axis (swing-twist of the local rotation against the T-pose rest), every frame of every clip, both arms. elbow = Arm vs ForeArm, wrist = ForeArm vs Hand: must stay <= maxDeg (Dom: 20). shoulder = Shoulder vs Arm (humerus rotation, anatomically larger) <= shoulderMaxDeg. shoulder: only frames where the arm is swung <= shoulderSwingMaxDeg from its T-pose direction (a straight reach across the body, e.g. the string hand before it is on the string, makes any roll number ill-defined; skipped frames are counted in the report).
